name: Pacific Electric Inc
old_description: Founded in 1978 by four colleagues with a simple mission — “Do what you say you’re going to do” — Pacific Electric was established on a foundation of truth, integrity, and hard work.
about:
Pacific Electric Inc was founded in 1978 in Corona, California, by four colleagues who set out with a simple mission: “Do what you say you’re going to do.” The company began as a hands-on operation focused on customized interconnection solutions for utilities, helping to shape what became known as the tap industry. In 2020, new ownership took the helm while preserving the original values and expanded the product line to include medium‑voltage equipment, panelboards, and switchboards.

Today Pacific Electric designs, manufactures, and delivers low‑ and medium‑voltage power distribution equipment, including switchgear, switchboards, panelboards, bus bar assemblies, and NEMA 3R or stainless‑steel enclosure wraps. The shop offers field bus modifications, breaker and component retrofits, and custom steel wraps with options such as sloped roofs, filtered louvers, and climate‑control accessories. Stocked bus bar assemblies can ship the same day, and all switchgear carries UL listing with integrated metering, communications, and monitoring.

The company serves commercial construction, industrial and institutional facilities, photovoltaic and EV infrastructure, data centers, healthcare, and emerging AI‑focused projects. Customers range from electrical contractors and facility managers to utility operators who need reliable upgrades or expansions without full system replacement.

Pacific Electric differentiates itself through a culture built on integrity, safety, and customer focus. Its retrofit approach extends equipment life and reduces downtime, while same‑day shipping on standard bus bars accelerates project schedules. The firm emphasizes sustainable practices and collaborative problem‑solving to meet evolving electrification demands.
